verses.text: If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If the stolen property is found in his mână alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to Dumnezeu, to find out whether or not he has put his mână on his neighbor’s să pleceods.

For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before Dumnezeu. He whom Dumnezeu condemns shall pay double to his neighbor. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the oath of the DOMNUL shall be between them both, he has not put his mână on his neighbor’s să pleceods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make să pleceod that which was torn.
If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If its owner is with it, he shall not make it să pleceod. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.
If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not allow a sorceress to live. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He who sacrifices to any să pleced, except to the DOMNUL only, shall be utterly destroyed.
You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the țară of Egipt.
You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If you lend money to any of poporul Meu with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun să plecees down,

for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for Eu sunt gracious. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not blaspheme Dumnezeu, nor curse a ruler of your people. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
